verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for subscribing to Unleash events. The only related items are a generic mention of integrating with GitHub, Slack and CI/CD tools, and the Admin API managing 'integrations'. Chat-app integrations do not qualify, and an unspecified integration list is adjacent at best, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
